values.en: An arc-length parameter exists on every regular smooth curve and is unique up to an additive constant and orientation: if $s_1,s_2$ are two arc-length parameters, there is a constant $c$ with $s_2=\pm s_1+c$. The $\pm$ is the freedom of reversing orientation and $c$ is the choice of base point. If the range is normalized to $[0,l]$, where $l$ is the total length and $\alpha(0),\alpha(l)$ are the endpoints, the arc-length parameter is unique outright.
values.zh-CN: 任一正则光滑曲线上都存在弧长参数，且在相差一个常数与定向的意义下唯一：若 $s_1,s_2$ 是两个弧长参数，则存在常数 $c$ 使 $s_2=\pm s_1+c$。$\pm$ 是反向定向的自由度，$c$ 是基点的选择。若进一步把取值范围约定为 $[0,l]$（$l$ 为曲线总长，$\alpha(0),\alpha(l)$ 为端点），则弧长参数完全唯一。
